title: IOE Lớp 4 - Chuyên đề 3 - Vòng Thành Phố

part_A.question: Linda: Hello. My name’s Linda. - Nam: …
options: C. It’s nice to see you.
part_A.answer: C. It’s nice to see you.
part_A.explanation: "Linda: Hello, my name's Linda. – Nam: It's nice to see you." – Lời chào gặp gỡ lần đầu.

part_A.question: Long is opposite to short, then large is to … .
part_A.explanation: "long ↔ short, large ↔ narrow" – Từ trái nghĩa: large (rộng) ↔ narrow (hẹp).

part_A.question: A person who goes to outer space is an ....
part_A.explanation: "astronaut" = phi hành gia; người đi vào vũ trụ (outer space).

part_A.question: What’s the weather like ______ spring? – It’s warm.
part_A.explanation: "in spring" – Trước tên mùa dùng giới từ "in": "in spring" (vào mùa xuân).

part_A.question: Mr. Phong is a … at Little Star Primary School.
part_A.explanation: "teacher" = giáo viên; "at Little Star Primary School" = tại trường tiểu học Little Star.

part_A.question: I need some flour to make a cake. I am going to the ... .
part_A.explanation: "bakery" = tiệm bánh; mua bột mì (flour) để làm bánh (make a cake).

part_A.question: It’s 7 o’clock in the morning and it’s time for … .
part_A.explanation: "time for breakfast" = đến giờ ăn sáng; 7 giờ sáng là giờ ăn sáng.

part_A.question: This is Alex. He is a taxi driver. He likes his … very much.
part_A.explanation: "job" = nghề nghiệp; "He likes his job very much" = anh ấy rất yêu nghề.

part_A.question: What is his full name? – It’s ….
part_A.explanation: "full name" = tên đầy đủ; gồm cả họ và tên (Daniel Parker).

part_A.question: Let’s go to the … to see ’’Frozen’’.
part_A.explanation: "cinema" = rạp chiếu phim; "go to the cinema to see..." = đi xem phim.

part_A.question: Listen! My sister ... in the next room.
part_A.explanation: "Listen! My sister is singing..." – Hiện tại tiếp diễn; "Listen!" = Nghe kìa!

part_A.question: Is the day long or short in the winter? – ....
part_A.explanation: "Is the day long or short in winter? – It's short." – Mùa đông ngày ngắn.

part_A.question: ... noise in the library, please!
part_A.explanation: "Don't make noise in the library, please!" – "make noise" = gây ồn ào; lệnh phủ định.

part_A.question: Does Mary like playing badminton? - … .
part_A.explanation: "Does Mary like...? – Yes, she does." – Câu hỏi ngôi 3 số ít; trả lời "Yes, she does."

part_A.question: What about going to the movies? - ...
part_A.explanation: "What about going to the movies? – That's a good idea." – Đề xuất + phản hồi đồng ý.

part_A.question: How much are your slippers? - ... .
part_A.explanation: "How much are your slippers? – They are 50,000 dong." – Hỏi giá nhiều vật "How much are...?"

part_A.question: A: What is your …? - B: I like dancing and drawing.
part_A.explanation: "What is your hobby? – I like dancing and drawing." – "hobby" = sở thích; liệt kê với "and".

part_A.question: The children are … the Christmas tree.
part_A.explanation: "The children are decorating the Christmas tree." – "decorate" = trang trí; hiện tại tiếp diễn.

part_A.question: What do you have ___ Thursdays? – I have Maths and English.
part_A.explanation: "What do you have on Thursdays? – I have Maths and English." – "on Thursdays" = vào thứ Năm.

part_A.question: Students all … when their English teacher comes in.
part_A.explanation: "Students all stand up when their English teacher comes in." – Phong tục lớp học.

part_A.question: My grandfather really … watching TV.
part_A.explanation: "My grandfather really loves watching TV." – love + V-ing; "really" = thực sự.

part_A.question: What’s the weather like in winter? - ...
part_A.explanation: "What's the weather like in winter? – It's cold." – Hỏi thời tiết; mùa đông lạnh.

part_A.question: Is your class …? – No, it is … . There are only ten students.
part_A.explanation: "Is your class big? – No, it is small. There are only ten students." – Đối lập big/small.

part_A.question: We go to school at … in the morning.
part_A.explanation: "We go to school at a quarter to seven." – "a quarter to seven" = 6 giờ 45 phút.

part_A.question: Do you like the new girl? - ….
options: A. Yes, he is very friendly.
B. Yes, I do. She is very funny.
part_A.answer: B. Yes, I do. She is very funny.
part_A.explanation: "Do you like the new girl? – Yes, I do. She is very funny." – Trả lời + nhận xét bổ sung.

part_A.question: Lien’s mother works as a (/an) … in a big factory.
part_A.explanation: "Lien's mother works as an engineer in a big factory." – "engineer" = kỹ sư.

part_A.question: On Sunday evenings, he ... at home, he usually goes out.
part_A.explanation: "On Sunday evenings, he isn't at home, he usually goes out." – "isn't at home" = không ở nhà.

part_A.question: ___? – It’s the twenty-first of December.
options: A. What is the date today?
B. What date is it today?
C. What day is it today?
D. What is the day today?
part_A.answer: A. What is the date today?
part_A.explanation: "What is the date today? – It's the twenty-first of December." – Hỏi ngày tháng hôm nay.

part_A.question: Kim: What kind of … do you play? - Hoa: I play table tennis.
part_A.explanation: "What kind of sports do you play? – I play table tennis." – "kind of sports" = loại thể thao.

part_A.question: Tom is my grandfather’s brother. He is older but he is … .
part_A.explanation: "He is older but he is stronger." – So sánh hơn với tính từ ngắn: old/strong → older/stronger.

part_A.question: This is the .... It has a sink, a tub and a shower.
part_A.explanation: "This is the bathroom. It has a sink, a tub and a shower." – "bathroom" = phòng tắm; mô tả đồ vật.

part_A.question: Children ... play football in the streets.
part_A.explanation: "Children can't play football in the streets." – "can't" = không được phép/không thể.

part_A.question: Would you like a cake? - Yes, ... .
part_A.explanation: "Would you like a cake? – Yes, please." – "Would you like...?" lời mời; trả lời "Yes, please."

part_A.question: I’m thirsty. I’d like ... .
part_A.explanation: "I'm thirsty. I'd like a packet of milk." – "a packet of milk" = một hộp sữa.

part_A.question: Tom: Goodbye, Linda. - Linda: Goodbye, Tom. …
options: A. Nice to see you again.
part_A.explanation: "Goodbye, Tom. See you later." – Tạm biệt; "See you later" = Hẹn gặp lại sau.

part_A.question: A: Where do you have ….? - B: In the school canteen after morning classes.
part_A.explanation: "Where do you have lunch? – In the school canteen after morning classes." – Hỏi nơi ăn trưa.

part_A.question: Why does your mother go to the food stall? - Because she wants some ....
part_A.explanation: "Why does your mother go to the food stall? – Because she wants some hamburgers." – "food stall" = quầy thức ăn.

part_A.question: Ron ______ some trees in the garden yesterday morning.
part_A.explanation: "Ron planted some trees in the garden yesterday morning." – Quá khứ đơn: plant → planted.

part_A.question: The members come from … . They speak … .
part_A.explanation: "The members come from France. They speak French." – Người Pháp nói tiếng Pháp (French).

part_A.question: I like my grandmother’s house. It is a ….
part_A.explanation: "I like my grandmother's house. It is a beautiful new house." – Thứ tự tính từ: beautiful + new.

part_A.question: ___ - He is a football player.
options: A. Which is your brother work?
B. What does your brother do?
C. Which does your brother work?
D. What is your brother do?
part_A.answer: B. What does your brother do?
part_A.explanation: "What does your brother do? – He is a football player." – Hỏi nghề nghiệp + trả lời.

part_A.question: My mother is a … . She works in a big and new office in London.
part_A.explanation: "My mother is a clerk. She works in a big and new office in London." – "clerk" = nhân viên văn phòng.

part_A.question: Can Tom swim ... play football? - Yes, he can.
part_A.explanation: "Can Tom swim and play football? – Yes, he can." – "and" nối hai hoạt động trong câu "Can".

part_A.question: I seldom … late at night. I often go to bed before 10.
part_A.explanation: "I seldom stay up late at night." – "seldom" = hiếm khi; "stay up late" = thức khuya.

part_A.question: What … your hobbies? – I … apples and chicken.
part_A.explanation: "What are your hobbies? – I like apples and chicken." – "hobbies" (số nhiều) → trả lời nhiều sở thích.

part_A.question: My _ _ _ _ town is Hanoi.
part_A.explanation: "_home_town" → "hometown" = quê hương; điền "home". "My hometown is Hanoi."

part_A.question: These are their paint_ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "paint_ings_" → "paintings" = các bức tranh; điền "ings". "These are their paintings."

part_A.question: It’s very dark there. I c_ n’t see anything.
part_A.explanation: "c_a_n't" → "can't" = không thể; điền "a". "I can't see anything."

part_A.question: How _ _ _ is she? – She is 11 years old.
part_A.explanation: "_old_" → "old" = tuổi; điền "old". "How old is she? – She is 11 years old."

part_A.question: We often go f_ _ _ ing in autumn.
part_A.explanation: "f_ish_ing" → "fishing" = câu cá; điền "ish". "go fishing in autumn."

part_A.question: It’s _ _ _ in summer.
part_A.explanation: "_hot_" → "hot" = nóng; điền "hot". "It's hot in summer."

part_A.question: Her c_ _ _ any is next to our house.
part_A.explanation: "c_omp_any" → "company" = công ty; điền "omp". "Her company is next to our house."

part_A.question: Ra_ _ _ your hand, children.
part_A.explanation: "Ra_ise_" → "Raise" = giơ (tay); điền "ise". "Raise your hand, children."

part_A.question: Nam is w_ _ _ ing a very nice belt.
part_A.explanation: "w_ear_ing" → "wearing" = đang mặc; điền "ear". "Nam is wearing a very nice belt."

part_A.question: Are they from _ _ _ tralia?
part_A.explanation: "_aus_tralia" → "Australia" = nước Úc; điền "aus". (Lưu ý: viết hoa trong câu đầy đủ)

part_A.question: Tokyo is the capital of J_ _ _ n.
part_A.explanation: "J_apa_n" → "Japan" = Nhật Bản; điền "apa". Tokyo là thủ đô của Nhật Bản.

part_A.question: Do you want a glass _ _ milk? – No, thanks.
part_A.explanation: "_of_" → "of" = của; điền "of". "a glass of milk" = một ly sữa.

part_A.question: Close _ _ at door, please. I’m very cold.
part_A.explanation: "_th_at" → "that" = cái đó; điền "th". "Close that door, please."

part_A.question: Is that a ro_ nd box? – No, it’s a square box.
part_A.explanation: "ro_u_nd" → "round" = tròn; điền "u". "a round box" = hộp tròn ↔ "square box" = hộp vuông.

part_A.question: What is your bi_ _ _ day? – It’s in May.
part_A.explanation: "bi_rth_day" → "birthday" = sinh nhật; điền "rth". "What is your birthday? – It's in May."

part_A.question: My aunt is a housew_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "housew_ife_" → "housewife" = nội trợ; điền "ife". "My aunt is a housewife."

part_A.question: Wh_ _ _ are the maps? – They are on the wall.
part_A.explanation: "Wh_ere_" → "Where" = ở đâu; điền "ere". "Where are the maps? – They are on the wall."

part_A.question: How _ _ _ you today, David? – I’m fine, thank you.
part_A.explanation: "_are_" → "are" = (to be số nhiều); điền "are". "How are you today, David?"

part_A.question: This tree has a _ _ _ of green leaves.
part_A.explanation: "_lot_" → "lot" = nhiều; điền "lot". "a lot of green leaves" = rất nhiều lá xanh.

part_A.question: There are _ _ _ ’T’ in the word ’PRETTY’.
part_A.explanation: "_two_" → "two" = hai; điền "two". Có hai chữ 'T' trong từ 'PRETTY'.

part_A.question: I’m in _ _ _ _ _ 4A.
part_A.explanation: "_class_" → "class" = lớp học; điền "class". "I'm in class 4A."

part_A.question: Malaysia is a count_ _ in Southeast Asia.
part_A.explanation: "count_ry_" → "country" = đất nước; điền "ry". "Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia."

part_A.question: September is the n_ _ _ _ month of the year.
part_A.explanation: "n_inth_" → "ninth" = thứ chín (số thứ tự); điền "inth". Tháng 9 là tháng thứ 9.

part_A.question: Open the book and r_ _ d after me, please.
part_A.explanation: "r_ea_d" → "read" = đọc; điền "ea". "Open the book and read after me, please."

part_A.question: It’s not rainy today. It’s s_ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "s_unny_" → "sunny" = nắng; điền "unny". "It's not rainy today. It's sunny."

part_A.question: I never skip my break_ _ _ _ in the morning.
part_A.explanation: "break_fast_" → "breakfast" = bữa sáng; điền "fast". "never skip my breakfast."

part_A.question: Here are your shoes. – T_ _ _ _ s.
part_A.explanation: "T_hank_s" → "Thanks" = cảm ơn; điền "hank". "Here are your shoes. – Thanks."

part_A.question: Thank you. – You are w_ _ _ _ me.
part_A.explanation: "w_elco_me" → "welcome" = chào mừng/không có gì; điền "elco". "You are welcome."

part_A.question: Are you b_ _ _ these days? – No, I’m quite free.
part_A.explanation: "b_usy_" → "busy" = bận rộn; điền "usy". "Are you busy these days?"

part_A.question: My elder brother is very y_ _ _ _ and tall.
part_A.explanation: "y_oung_" → "young" = trẻ; điền "oung". "My elder brother is very young and tall."

part_A.question: Don’t _ _ _ _ noise when you are in class.
part_A.explanation: "_make_" → "make" = gây ra; điền "make". "Don't make noise when you are in class."

part_A.question: My favorite _ _ _ _ is beef.
part_A.explanation: "_food_" → "food" = thức ăn; điền "food". "My favorite food is beef."

part_A.question: She _ _ _ _ _ her bike to school.
part_A.explanation: "_rides_" → "rides" = cưỡi/đạp (ngôi 3 số ít); điền "rides". "She rides her bike to school."

part_A.question: Please, s_ _ _ l your name again.
part_A.explanation: "s_pel_l" → "spell" = đánh vần; điền "pel". "Please, spell your name again."

part_A.question: How m_ _ y books are there? – There are eleven books.
part_A.explanation: "m_an_y" → "many" = nhiều (đếm được); điền "an". "How many books are there?"

part_A.question: Everyday, I get up early to _ _ morning exercise.
part_A.explanation: "_do_" → "do" = làm; điền "do". "do morning exercise" = tập thể dục buổi sáng.

part_A.question: My school is in Bat Trang Vill_ _ _ . It’s very big.
part_A.explanation: "Vill_age_" → "Village" = làng; điền "age". "Bat Trang Village."

part_A.question: Is that lit_ _ _ boy your friend? – Yes, his name is Tom.
part_A.explanation: "lit_tle_" → "little" = nhỏ; điền "tle". "that little boy" = cậu bé nhỏ kia.

part_A.question: Jim can speak Fren_ _ but cannot speak English.
part_A.explanation: "Fren_ch_" → "French" = tiếng Pháp; điền "ch". "Jim can speak French."

part_A.question: Co_ _ t from one to fifteen, please.
part_A.explanation: "Co_un_t" → "Count" = đếm; điền "un". "Count from one to fifteen."

part_A.question: We are having l_ _ ch in the canteen.
part_A.explanation: "l_un_ch" → "lunch" = bữa trưa; điền "un". "We are having lunch in the canteen."

part_A.question: What can you do? – I can _ _ _ _ a bike.
part_A.explanation: "_ride_" → "ride" = đạp/lái; điền "ride". "I can ride a bike."

part_A.question: - What does your father _ _ _ _ like? - He’s short.
part_A.explanation: "_look_" → "look" = trông như thế nào; điền "look". "What does your father look like?"

part_A.question: What is his full _ _ _ _ ? – He is Anton Fall.
part_A.explanation: "_name_" → "name" = tên; điền "name". "What is his full name?"

part_A.question: See you _ _ _ _ r, George.
part_A.explanation: "_late_r" → "later" = sau này; điền "late". "See you later, George."

part_A.question: We have lunch at sc_ _ _ _ at 11 a.m.
part_A.explanation: "sc_hool_" → "school" = trường học; điền "hool". "We have lunch at school at 11 a.m."

part_A.question: The pencil is long but the rubber is sh_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "sh_ort_" → "short" = ngắn; điền "ort". "the rubber is short" ↔ "the pencil is long".

part_A.question: My teachers go to school ea_ _ _ in the morning.
part_A.explanation: "ea_rly_" → "early" = sớm; điền "rly". "My teachers go to school early in the morning."

part_A.question: Taylor Swift is Ameri_ _ _ singer.
part_A.explanation: "Ameri_can_" → "American" = người/tiếng Mỹ; điền "can". Taylor Swift là ca sĩ người Mỹ.

part_A.question: What was the _ _ _ e yesterday? - It was December 20th.
part_A.explanation: "_dat_e" → "date" = ngày tháng; điền "dat". "What was the date yesterday?"

part_A.question: Don’t visit Paris in J_ _ _ . June is better.
part_A.explanation: "J_uly_" → "July" = tháng Bảy; điền "uly". Đừng đến Paris vào tháng Bảy.

part_A.question: What _ _ _ _ _ is it? – It’s October.
part_A.explanation: "_month_" → "month" = tháng; điền "month". "What month is it? – It's October."

part_A.question: Look at this house. It doesn’t have a _ _ _ room to sleep in.
part_A.explanation: "_bed_room" → "bedroom" = phòng ngủ; điền "bed". Nhà không có phòng ngủ.

part_A.question: Let’s visit Granny this _ _ _ _ end.
part_A.explanation: "_week_end" → "weekend" = cuối tuần; điền "week". "this weekend" = cuối tuần này.

part_A.question: We _ _ _ _ _ the school bus every morning.
part_A.explanation: "_catch_" → "catch" = bắt; điền "catch". "catch the school bus" = bắt xe buýt trường.

part_A.question: What t_ _ _ is it? Let's go or we will be late for lunch.
part_A.explanation: "t_ime_" → "time" = giờ; điền "ime". "What time is it? Let's go or we will be late."

part_A.question: Look at the blackb_ _ _ d, please.
part_A.explanation: "blackb_oar_d" → "blackboard" = bảng đen; điền "oar". "Look at the blackboard."

part_A.question: I am hungry. Let’s go to the f_ _ _ stall.
part_A.explanation: "f_ood_" → "food" = thức ăn; điền "ood". "food stall" = quầy/hàng ăn.

part_A.question: What _ _ _ _ is it? – It’s five thirty.
part_A.explanation: "_time_" → "time" = giờ; điền "time". "What time is it? – It's five thirty."

part_A.question: A: Good n_ _ _ _ , Mom. - B: Have a good sleep, my son.
part_A.explanation: "n_ight_" → "night" = đêm/tối; điền "ight". "Good night, Mom."

part_A.question: ’’What _ _ _ _ does your father go to work?’’ – ’’At half past six.’’
part_A.explanation: "_time_" → "time" = giờ; điền "time". "What time does your father go to work?"

part_A.question: Unscramble this word: athms -> _ _ _ _ _
part_A.explanation: "_maths_" → "maths" = môn Toán; điền "maths". Sắp xếp lại chữ: athms → maths.

part_A.question: My father’s brother is my _ _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "_uncle_" → "uncle" = chú/bác trai; điền "uncle". Anh trai của bố là chú của bạn.

part_A.question: What _ _ _ _ do you have lunch? – I have lunch at 12 p.m.
part_A.explanation: "_time_" → "time" = giờ; điền "time". "What time do you have lunch?"

part_A.question: What _ _ _ _ do your classes start? – At 7.30.
part_A.explanation: "_time_" → "time" = giờ; điền "time". "What time do your classes start? – At 7.30."

part_A.question: Let’s / break time. / do / at / puzzles /
part_A.answer: Let’s do puzzles at break time.
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Let's do puzzles at break time." – "puzzles" = trò chơi ô chữ; "at break time" = giờ ra chơi.

part_A.question: skateboard? – No, / brother / he can’t. / Can your /
part_A.answer: Can your brother skateboard? – No, he can’t.
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Can your brother skateboard? – No, he can't." – "skateboard" = chơi ván trượt.

part_A.question: singers? / their / cousins / Are /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Are their cousins singers?" – Are + chủ ngữ + danh từ nghề nghiệp?

part_A.question: go to see / Where / can / I / animals? /
part_A.answer: Where can I go to see animals?
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Where can I go to see animals?" – Where + can + chủ ngữ + V?

part_A.question: would / What / for / you like / breakfast tomorrow? /
part_A.answer: What would you like for breakfast tomorrow?
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "What would you like for breakfast tomorrow?" – "Would you like" + cho bữa sáng.

part_A.question: play / at / break time. / basketball / Let’s /
part_A.answer: Let’s play basketball at break time.
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Let's play basketball at break time." – "Let's + V"; "basketball" = bóng rổ.

part_A.question: like / glass / a / of lemonade? / Would you /
part_A.answer: Would you like a glass of lemonade?
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Would you like a glass of lemonade?" – "a glass of lemonade" = một ly nước chanh.

part_A.question: the / room. / computer / Let’s / go to /
part_A.answer: Let’s go to the computer room.
